seo.titulo: What Would You Do? — perguntas de cenário na entrevista em inglês — Aula 5
seo.descricao: Responda perguntas hipotéticas de entrevista em inglês sem travar: Second Conditional, cliente insatisfeito, prazo apertado e erro na frente da equipe. Aula 5 do curso de Entrevista da Capy English.

hero.sub: Cliente insatisfeito, discordar do gestor, erro na frente de todo mundo. O entrevistador não quer a resposta certa — quer ver como você pensa em voz alta.

dialogo.sub: 🤔 A entrevista vira para perguntas de cenário. Daniel testa julgamento: cliente insatisfeito, discordância com o gestor, prazo impossível, erro em público.

vocab.ex: Let's move on to a few scenario questions.
What would you do if a client wasn't happy?
What if you disagreed with your manager?
If two teammates were arguing, what would you do?
I'd rank them by deadline and impact.
I prioritize by deadline and impact.
Hiding a mistake is always worse.
We solved it by talking calmly.
What if you disagreed with the decision?
How do you handle tight deadlines?
If I didn't know how to solve it, I'd ask.

expressoes.usage: a estrutura pronta para qualquer pergunta de cenário — decore esta e você responde todas
expressoes.example: If that happened, I would listen carefully first.

expressoes.usage: a melhor primeira frase para conflito: mostra que você não reage no impulso
expressoes.example: If a client wasn't happy, I'd listen carefully first, and then I'd offer a solution.

expressoes.usage: responder sobre erro sem se defender — é o que o entrevistador procura
expressoes.example: I'd admit it right away. Hiding a mistake is always worse.

expressoes.expr: I'd ask for help if I needed it.
expressoes.usage: mostrar que pedir ajuda é método, não fraqueza
expressoes.example: I'd rank them by deadline, and I'd ask for help if I really needed it.

gramatica.sub: Um único ponto: falar do hipotético. Toda pergunta de cenário vem nessa forma — e a resposta tem que vir nela também, senão soa como se você estivesse contando algo que aconteceu de verdade.

blocos.t: if + passado simples, would + verbo base
blocos.ex: "If a client wasn't happy, I would listen first."
blocos.corpo:
As duas metades têm formas diferentes, e trocar é o erro clássico:

✅ If a client wasn't happy, I would listen.
❌ If a client wouldn't be happy… (nunca "would" depois do if)
❌ If a client wasn't happy, I will listen. (will é para o real)

blocos.ex: "If I had more time…" (mas eu não tenho)
blocos.corpo:
O passado aqui não fala do passado — fala do irreal agora.

✅ If I had more time, I'd finish it. (hoje, mas não tenho)
✅ If I didn't know how to solve it, I'd ask a teammate.

É por isso que se chama "conditional" e não "past".

blocos.t: I'd — a contração que você VAI ouvir
blocos.corpo:
Na fala real, would quase nunca aparece inteiro. Vira 'd, colado no sujeito.

I would → I'd  ·  He would → He'd  ·  They would → They'd

Cuidado: I'd também pode ser I had. O que vem depois resolve: I'd listen (verbo base = would) × I'd listened (particípio = had).

No inglês formal, o Second Conditional usa were para todos os sujeitos.

✅ If I were you, I'd accept it. (fixo, nunca "if I was you" numa entrevista)
✅ If he were here…

Na conversa do dia a dia was aparece muito, mas If I were you é expressão pronta — não mude.

linhas: If I were you, I'd ask.
tabela.nota: Nunca coloque "would" depois do if. A regra vale para os dois lados: if leva passado, would leva base.

conversation.q: "What would you do if a client wasn't happy with your work?"
"What if you disagreed with your manager's decision?"
"If you had too many tasks and not enough time, how would you prioritize?"
"What would you do if you made a mistake in front of the whole team?"
"What would you do if two teammates were arguing?"
"If you didn't know how to solve a problem, what would you do?"
"How do you handle pressure or tight deadlines?"
Dê um conselho usando "If I were you…".
starters: If I were in that position,...

quiz.q: "O que você faria se um cliente não estivesse satisfeito?"
opts: What would you do if a client wasn't happy?
What would you do if a client wouldn't be happy?
What will you do if a client isn't happy?
What you would do if a client wasn't happy?
quiz.a: What would you do if a client wasn't happy?
quiz.rule: Depois de if vem o passado simples — nunca would.

opts: If that happened, I would listen first.
If that would happen, I would listen first.
If that happened, I will listen first.
If that happen, I would listened first.
quiz.a: If that happened, I would listen first.
quiz.rule: if + passado, would + verbo base. Nunca os dois no mesmo lado.

opts: na forma base (listen)
no passado (listened)
no gerúndio (listening)
com to (to listen)
If I were you, I'd accept it.
If I was you, I'd accept it.
If I were you, I'll accept it.
If I am you, I'd accept it.
quiz.a: If I were you, I'd accept it.
quiz.rule: If I were you é expressão pronta — nunca "was" numa entrevista.

opts: I would listen
I had listen
I did listen
I will listen
quiz.rule: 'd + verbo base = would. Se viesse particípio (listened), aí seria had.

quiz.q: "Se eu tivesse mais tempo, eu terminaria hoje."
opts: If I had more time, I'd finish it today.
If I have more time, I'd finish it today.
If I had more time, I'll finish it today.
If I would have more time, I'd finish it today.
quiz.a: If I had more time, I'd finish it today.
quiz.rule: O passado aqui não é passado — é o irreal de agora.

opts: respectfully
calmly
honestly
directly
I'd ask for help if I really needed it.
I'd ask for help if I really need it.
I'll ask for help if I really needed it.
I'd ask help if I really needed it.
quiz.a: I'd ask for help if I really needed it.
quiz.rule: A ordem pode inverter, mas as formas não mudam. E é ask FOR help.

verbsQuiz.q: If a client ___ happy, I'd listen first. (be — negativo, passado)
If that happened, I ___ listen carefully. (would — contraído ou não)
If I ___ you, I'd accept it. (be — forma fixa da expressão)

speak: What would you do if a client wasn't happy?
If that happened, I would listen carefully first.
If I didn't know how to solve it, I'd ask a teammate.
I try to stay calm and break the work into smaller steps.
If I were you, I'd do the same.

ordem.s: if that happened i would listen carefully first

erro.enunciado: Corrija a frase: "If a client would be unhappy, I would listen."
aceitas: if a client was unhappy i would listen
if a client were unhappy i would listen
if a client wasn't happy i would listen
erro.dica: Depois do if nunca vem would — vem o passado simples.
